entities.summary: Gustav Struve, known as Gustav von Struve until he gave up his title, was a German surgeon, politician, lawyer and publicist, and a revolutionary during the German revolutions of 1848–1849 in Baden. He also spent over a decade in the United States and was active there as a reformer.
